Honest scope. Capture is outbound-only: it proves what the agent sent, including its own half of the TCP handshake, not that the target replied. Target responsiveness is monitor data.
Pull compares the manifest on the main server with the agent's, downloads only missing or changed segments and checks each one's SHA-256. An interrupted transfer resumes inside the segment. Idle agents may also push pending segments on their own.
